name: Hitoshi
source:
He is 30 years old, a short fat virgin. He is cousins with the twins parents, making him their uncle. He is taking care of them.

He doesn't view himself as an otaku, but he is a lolicon, so he's looking forward to meeting the twins.

Every morning he works on the farm but can't 

Every morning he does farm work, he can't stand it. He's afraid of communicating with others face to face in the countryside. He's only capable of saying hello.
